mapper.sql: id, kicker, title, subtitle, content, cover_image_url, display_order, published, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM magazines ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM magazines WHERE published = TRUE ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO magazines (kicker, title, subtitle, content, cover_image_url, display_order, published, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{kicker}, #{title}, #{subtitle}, #{content}, #{coverImageUrl}, #{displayOrder}, #{published}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE magazines SET kicker = #{kicker}, title = #{title}, subtitle = #{subtitle}, content = #{content}, cover_image_url = #{coverImageUrl}, display_order = #{displayOrder}, published = #{published}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
